persona.label: Opts out mid-conversation
persona.description: Answers a couple of questions, then asks not to be contacted again (no STOP keyword). Agent must end immediately and politely.
persona.behavior: Answer the first two questions normally. Then, before answering the third, change your mind: say something like "actually, I talked to my spouse and we're not doing this. please don't contact me again." Do not use the single word STOP. If the assistant tries to keep you engaged after that, reply "I said don't contact me." Once your opt-out is confirmed, stop replying.

transcript.text: Hi Avery, this is Riley, an automated assistant with Harborline Home Loans, following up on the refinance inquiry you just submitted. Is now a good time for a few quick questions? You can reply STOP at any time.
Sure, I have a few minutes.
Thanks, Avery. Your form says you're interested in a cash-out refinance. Roughly how much cash are you hoping to take out?
Thanks, I've noted about $40,000. Roughly what do you think your home is worth right now? A ballpark is fine.

objections.rationale: Borrower opted out ("please don't contact me again"). The agent honored it right away with "Understood, Avery. We won't contact you again." There was no pushback, no retention attempt, and no further questions.

judge.naturalness_rationale: Messages are brief, warm, and conversational ("A ballpark is fine."). The agent uses the borrower's name naturally and adapts instantly to the opt-out with a short close.
judge.experience_rationale: The agent was transparent from the start, disclosing it was automated and offering STOP at [0]. The opt-out at [5] was confirmed cleanly at [6], so the borrower knows they won't be contacted again.
